lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What about did you have ‘er bra and panties too?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So you took it outside and threw it on the fire.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Now the shirt, earlier you told us the shirt had blood on it, had a hole in it, was that not true then?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So that wasn’t true? (Brendan shakes head “no”) (pause) So what’d ya do in the ki-garage now? What kind of cleaning, what do you do, how do you do it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We threw gas on it so he could get it off. Then he tried paint thinner and then he went to bleach to get it off and like, he like, probably like, he went like he was spraying it like. I thought he got it on the floor and it splashed up on my pants or somethin’.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How much bleach, no let me go back. How much blood was there on the floor, quite a bit?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like by the lawn mower and where the jeeps’ tire was.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So if you had to say, some dimensions like 2 x 2, 2 feet by 2 feet, 10 X 10, how much blood do you think was there?
